title: Emergency Fund Planning & Liquidity Management
content: An Emergency Reserve Fund must precede long-term investing. Rule of thumb: Maintain 3 to 6 months of mandatory living expenses in highly liquid, capital-safe instruments such as High-Yield Savings Accounts, Liquid Mutual Funds, or Instant-Access Bank FDs. Emergency funds protect long-term equity portfolios from forced premature liquidations during job transitions, medical emergencies, or market downturns.
